This page lists only the posts tagged **R**, and it exists for the feed:
aggregators such as [r-bloggers](https://www.r-bloggers.com) ask for a channel
carrying R content only, not the whole blog — which here also covers public
health, psychology and financial markets.

The feed is at [`/en/blog/r.xml`](r.xml). For the complete blog, the feed is
[`/en/blog/index.xml`](index.xml) and the post list is at [Blog](index.qmd).
